Batch 46 authoring is complete. I added three statistical definitions and four experiment records, populated both pages, and completed the batch evidence. The [manifest](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library-aqft-20261023/physics/research/advanced-qft-supersymmetry-build-2026-10-23-batch-46.pages.json) and [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library-aqft-20261023/physics/research/advanced-qft-supersymmetry-build-2026-10-23-batch-46.notes.md) record the scope and dependencies.

Five items have current, hash-closed **ready** records. Two remain **escalated**: the CMS multiboson record is limited to the accessible [official summary page](https://cms-results.web.cern.ch/cms-results/public-results/preliminary-results/SMP-25-002/) because the full PAS was inaccessible; the ATLAS tau search awaits the missing batch-34 supersymmetry-breaking page carrier. The detailed [source-resolution record](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library-aqft-20261023/physics/research/advanced-qft-supersymmetry-build-2026-10-23-batch-46.source-resolution.json) documents the CMS retrieval attempts. Full reports were reviewed for the [ATLAS global fit](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2604.21670v2), [CMS global fit](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2504.02958v2), and [ATLAS tau search](https://arxiv.org/html/2507.00296v2).

Scoped content-policy, dependency, rendering, proof-layout, precheck, proof-contract, coverage, and source-fetch checks passed. The assigned-item statement scan found no defects. Two broader checks remain blocked by other batches: the run-wide statement checker stops at batch 34’s empty inventory, and batch-level recomputation stops at six bare item IDs in batch 59. Both blockers are documented in the notes; I left those artifacts unchanged.
